			207 = {
				add_core_of = ROOT
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } transfer_state_to = ROOT }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_annex_terms_jerusalem }
				add_stability = 0.03
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_settlers_p5_tt

				}

				newline = yes
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta = -10 }
					COLDWAR_ISR_change_standing = yes
				}
				if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = FRA modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_opinion_m10 } }
				if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } reverse_add_opinion_modifier = { target = GER modifier = COLDWAR_ISR_opinion_m10 } }

enbo_aipac_category = {
	COLDWAR_ISR_aipac_arms_lobby = {
		icon = GFX_decision_enbo_aipac
		allowed = { original_tag = ISR }
		visible = {
			original_tag = ISR
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_initialized
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_aipac_unlock }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = enbo_aipac_terminated }
			NOT = { AND = { country_exists = USA USA = { has_country_flag = enbo_aipac_ended } } }
		}
		available = {
			country_exists = USA
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_trig_aipac_cd_tt NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_aipac_cooldown } }
			NOT = { has_war_with = USA }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_trig_usa_clear_tt USA = { COLDWAR_ISR_pair_clear = yes } }
		}
		cost = 50
		fire_only_once = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_ISR_aipac_arms_lobby"
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_ISR_aipac_cooldown days = 180 }
			USA = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ISR.130 days = 1 } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			effect_tooltip = {
				ROOT = {
					add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_ISR_friends_on_capitol_hill days = 180 }
					newline = yes
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = { value = gdp_total multiply = -0.005 } }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_ISR_diaspora_m3_tt
					newline = yes
					hidden_effect = {
						set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_ISR_meter_delta = -3 }
						COLDWAR_ISR_change_diaspora = yes
					}
				}
				USA = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_ISR_congressional_pressure days = 180 } }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 2 USA = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value > 25 } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 USA = { has_opinion = { target = ROOT value < 0 } } }
		}
	}
